geojsonObject.description:
GeoJSON FeatureCollection to load directly.

Per RFC 7946, GeoJSON coordinates MUST be in WGS84 (EPSG:4326) longitude/latitude. This is the default assumption when `coordinateFormat` is omitted.

If your FeatureCollection is in a different CRS (e.g. a projected system such as EPSG:3395), you MUST set `coordinateFormat` explicitly to match the actual CRS of the input data. On a raster layer, `colorMapCenter` and `colorMapReverse` apply within it, and a `transferFunction` still sets opacity from the layer's own values. A categorical scheme ignores it, and it cannot be set with `colorMapDomain`. Read by the Autark adapter for raster and vector layers; the deck.gl adapter ignores it.

colorMapReverse.description: Run a raster layer's color scale from its highest value to its lowest, so the scheme's first color marks the highest value; with `colorMapRange`, from the range's high to its low. Read by the Autark adapter only.

backgroundLayerType.description: Name of that class. Defaults to `background`, and it must not be the type of a rendered layer.

includeBackground.description: Also count the pixels where no layer is drawn, such as the sky, as one more class.

aggregation.description: What each feature of the result receives: `classes`, the share of its frames' pixels each layer type covers, from 0 to 1; `objects`, for each object seen, the share of its frames that show it.

camera.description: The lens of the frames each viewpoint renders. Unlike a map's `camera`, which sets where a map view looks from, it sets no position or direction: `viewpoints` does.

clip.description: How near and how far from the viewpoint the frames show the layers, in workspace units.

fov.description: Field of view of each square frame, in degrees. Defaults to 90.

layerType.description: How the map draws the new table. Defaults to the type of the viewpoints table, or to `points` with the `building-windows` strategy, whose result holds one point per window.

sampling.description: The directions each viewpoint looks in, around the horizon. Read with the `centroid` strategy only.

azimuthOffsetDeg.description: Angle of the first direction, in degrees counterclockwise from east (0 looks east, 90 north); the others follow every 360 / `directions` degrees. Defaults to 0.

directions.description: Directions sampled around each viewpoint, evenly spaced. Defaults to 1.

pitchDeg.description: Angle of every direction above the horizontal, in degrees: up when positive, down when negative. Defaults to 0.

floors.description: Rows of windows on each facade, spread evenly up the building's height.

strategy.description: Where the viewpoints are: each feature's centroid (the default), looking in the directions `sampling` sets, or `building-windows`: windows along each building's facades, each looking out from the facade and 30 degrees to either side.
